dialogues.speaker: Marjorie
dialogues.text: "A flower that is not of this world"... Could that be referring to the real Windblume?

dialogues.speaker: Marjorie
dialogues.text: Ah, I'm sorry, I was preoccupied with thinking about something.

dialogues.speaker: Marjorie
dialogues.text: An adorable child bought a storybook from me, but I remember there being a rather strange riddle within its pages.

dialogues.speaker: Marjorie
dialogues.text: It might've been something that someone just accidentally left behind. You don't need to pay any special heed to it.
